rationale: Colin brings 20 years of experience in developer relations, ecosystem building, and AI infrastructure—skills directly applicable to helping Charlene navigate the intersection of design, business, and early-stage product work she's exploring. As someone who's mentored on developer relations strategy and built Dabl.Club to accelerate adoption through community, Colin can offer concrete guidance on how sales operations and design thinking apply to scaling developer-focused products.
intro_message: Colin Nebius, meet Charlene Smith — Colin's deep experience in developer relations and ecosystem building could help inform your career exploration at the intersection of design and business operations.
